description: Convert 5 of the 6 option schools on the Option A closure list to neighborhood schools (random combo 1 of 2, seed 20260610): Cedar Park, TOPS, Orca, Salmon Bay, Licton Springs (Boren stays option). Steady-state conversion semantics: each school's geozone becomes its attendance area, residents attend at the band's observed stay-rate, former lottery enrollees return to their areas' other destinations pro-rata.
